body:
## Affected files

- `docker/agents/entrypoint.sh` — the dsh provider-settings seeding block that writes `"$dsh_home/settings.yaml` with no `mkdir -p "$dsh_home"` beforehand.
- `lib/dsh-seed.sh` — the reference implementation (`dsh_seed_home()`) that does `mkdir -p "$DSH_HOME"` before the identical write.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `docker/agents/entrypoint.sh` creates `` (guarded `mkdir -p`) before the `sed ... > "/settings.yaml"` redirect.
- [ ] The entrypoint still starts when `DSH_HOME` points at a path that does not exist yet (e.g. `DSH_HOME=/tmp/x/a/b`).
- [ ] An existing operator-customised `settings.yaml` is still never overwritten.
- [ ] ShellCheck passes on the changed file.
- [ ] No default constants (`DSH_CONTEXT_WINDOW`, `CLAUDE_TIMEOUT`, `MAX_DIFF`, `DIFF_THRESHOLD`, `DIGEST_CAP`) move.

## Related

- #2009 (sibling — same PR #2008 review)
- #2011 (sibling — same PR #2008 review)

## Affected files

- `lib/dsh-seed.sh` — `dsh_seed_home()` hardcodes `"/settings-llamacpp.yaml"`.
- `docker/agents/entrypoint.sh` — the provider-aware seeding to mirror (`DSH_PROVIDER` + `^[a-z0-9-]+$` guard).
- `tests/acceptance/issue-1836.sh`, `tests/acceptance/issue-1837.sh` — extend for provider selection.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `dsh_seed_home()` selects `/opt/dsh/settings-llamacpp.yaml`.
- [ ] The provider name is validated with the same `^[a-z0-9-]+$` guard as `docker/agents/entrypoint.sh`.
- [ ] A missing or invalid provider template warns on stderr and seeds nothing (no silent llama.cpp fallback).
- [ ] The acceptance tests cover both the default `llamacpp` provider and a named provider.
- [ ] ShellCheck passes on the changed files.

## Related

- #2010 (sibling — same PR #2008 review; independent fix, no dependency)
- #2011 (sibling — same PR #2008 review)
